An '''individual''' was the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the ''[[Bhishana Bhaga]]'', a [[guardian corvette]] owned by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when the [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] experienced a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] malfunction, dropped out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in an [[Unidentified asteroid field (Krykas V)|asteroid belt]], and crashed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Krykas V]].
